note: Observed cloud dataset projected to factual fields. Captions, descriptions, social titles and image URLs are omitted; content_hash belongs to the original full row. Source observations are historical, not current promises.
limits: Named public Facebook Page /Page/posts/ID or /Page/posts/pfbid URLs only. No Page-feed discovery, personal profiles, groups, search, share links, /reel/ URLs, comments, commenters, media downloads or account login. The source must identify the post author as a public Page; otherwise the target fails without a source fee. Reactions include all reaction types, not only likes. Missing counters remain null. A post may resolve to a canonical permalink; its numeric dataset ID is stable when the public source exposes it.
